claims.statement: In the unpaid compact coherent triangle cross branch ||A[T,O]||op>1/2, after pivoting on the largest compact-cell diagonal a, either ||A[i,O]||2>1/8 or one of the two residual Schur rows into O has norm >1/(4sqrt(2)).

If a physical residual Schur hub row c has ||c||2>1/(4sqrt(2)) and every physical residual cut is within sqrt(10)/64 in Frobenius norm of rank one, then either some hub edge has modulus >1/8, or O partitions into nonempty original-coordinate banks U,V with hub-bank norms >1/(8sqrt(2)), aligned directions having sine-angle error <sqrt(5)/4, and ||S[U,V]-lambda q_U q_V^T||F<sqrt(10)/32.

If every physical cut of a symmetric matrix has rank at most one, then around any hub with at least three nonzero offdiagonal neighbors, all offdiagonal coefficients on the hub support have the form kappa c_i c_j and all offdiagonal coefficients touching the complement vanish.

Pay, with a universal essential-density constant under the full product-source hypotheses and arbitrary self blocks/couplings, the remaining physical pivot-star, heavy physical Schur edge, and balanced aligned-bank packets, or reduce each source-preservingly to an existing paid packet.
